Body of every error response. The frontend picks its text by error_code.

Some errors add fields of their own (e.g. `required_confirmation_level`,
`allowed_statuses`, `unknown_apartment_ids`); docs/API.md lists them per endpoint.

InvitationPreview.title: InvitationPreview
InvitationPreview.description: What an invitation grants, shown to the holder of its link only.

LinkCodeResponse.title: LinkCodeResponse

(false when there is none, and for a cancelled poll).

values and bounds canonical.

Totals of one question; at most one of options, number, dates and texts is set, by its
kind (number stays null while nobody answered, texts are for the board only).
